source_row.rationale: Increased dyspnea, increased sputum volume, and increased sputum purulence together are classic signs of a COPD exacerbation, requiring prompt evaluation and likely treatment adjustment (such as bronchodilators, corticosteroids, or antibiotics depending on presentation).
